args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1). Rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. Rollback verified as rolled_out.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing (healthy: false, error rate 0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` (status: rolled_out).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.
